name: Notion

tiers.how: Sage connects to Notion via the official Notion API using an Internal Integration Token stored in the OS credential store. The owner must create an integration at notion.so/my-integrations, share the target pages or databases explicitly with that integration, and store the token via setup_creds. Page creates and updates require an approval card.
always_tap: any page shared externally or published

gotchas: The integration must be explicitly shared with every page or database it needs to access; access is not inherited by default.
Notion's block API paginates at 100 blocks per request; large pages require multiple calls.
Notion does not have a native publish or share action; sharing a page link is always a manual owner step.
The Notion API version is specified in the request header; pin to a known stable version.
notes: Notion is used for knowledge management and project wikis; Sage reads and writes notes internally but never publishes pages externally without owner approval.
